item.title: DOEDSVANGR Release First Track ‘Black Sun Dissolution’ from Upcoming Album
item.description: Black metal outfit Doedsvangr unveil the first strike from their upcoming third full-length Within The Flesh; the new single ‘Black Sun Dissolution’ which is now streamingon all platforms. Alongside the track’s release, pre-orders for Within The Flesh are officially live ahead of the album’s release on the 10th of April via Soulseller Records. Pre-order Within The Flesh here:–World: https://soulsellerrecords.bandcamp.com–US: https://soulsellerrecords.aisamerch.com Frontman Doedsadmiral comments

item.title: NEVERMORE Announce Signing to Reigning Phoenix Music & Forthcoming Show with New Line-Up
item.description: Legendary heavy metal powerhouse NEVERMORE have signed with Reigning Phoenix Music. The band also welcomes to the line-up Jack Cattoi on guitar, Semir Özerkan on bass, and new vocalist Berzan Önen. To showcase the new lineup, NEVERMORE’s first live appearance will take place on April 1st, 2026, in Istanbul, Turkey.
